introTitle: What would you like to work on?
intro: Describe your goal here. Start a conversation now; files and project setup can be added when needed.
直接在下方描述目标，就能开始对话。资料与项目配置可以按需补充，不是开聊前置条件。
suggest1: Discuss an improvement before writing code
先讨论一项改进，暂时不写代码
suggest2: Explain a screenshot or a document
suggest3: 接着推进现有项目任务
messagePlaceholder: 向 AI 团队描述你的需求…
composerNote: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Sending a message does not approve code changes.
Enter 发送 · Shift+Enter 换行 · 发送聊天消息不等于批准代码修改。
emptyExec: Discuss in the middle. When the deliverable is clear, hand it to Codex once and follow its progress here.
在中间讨论，明确交付内容后，一次交给 Codex，在这里查看进展与成果。
rightFoot: Your conversation remains available while a task runs. Approvals apply only to the reviewed task and scope.
执行中仍能继续对话。批准仅适用于已审查的具体任务与范围。
execTitle: 改进工作台空状态提示
allowedValue: 一项界面改进＋定向测试
previewNote: Stored locally. Only attachments selected for a message are sent to the model.
附件保存在本机。只有本次发送明确选中的附件才发给模型。
pluginDescription: Read only the selected sources in this project. Search results will be shown and included only when you send.
只读检索本项目明确选中的资料。检索结果在发送时展示并进入模型上下文。
detailDescription: Project management is a side destination. Return to the same conversation, draft and execution without losing your place.
项目管理是辅助页面。返回后仍是同一对话、草稿与执行现场，不丢失上下文。
sourceDesc: No source is required to start a conversation. Add sources here or attach them directly to a message.
开始对话无需资料。可以在这里添加资料，也可以直接随消息附上。
teamDesc: Connect the discussion model and Codex separately. Show the real connection, model identity and granted scope; never use a logo as proof of a live connection.
分别连接对话模型与 Codex，显示真实连接、模型身份及授权范围；不能用一个图标冒充真实接入。
tasksDesc: Execution tasks are linked to conversations. An ordinary chat message does not automatically become a coding task.
执行任务与聊天关联。普通聊天消息不会自动变成代码执行任务。
deliverDesc: Read outputs, compare versions and return to the conversation that produced them.
阅读成果、对比版本，并返回产生它的对话。
overviewDesc: Goals, recent work and pending decisions live here. The workbench is the default entry, not this overview page.
这里汇总目标、近期工作与待决定事项。默认入口是工作台，而不是这张概览页。
sourcesEmpty: No sources yet. You can still send a text message.
暂无资料，仍然可以直接发送文字。
allHidden: Keep at least one pane open.
handoffBusy: An execution is active. Continue discussing; revise its scope only through a new approval.
当前任务正在执行。可以继续讨论，变更执行范围需要新的明确批准。
resumeHint: Conversations stay scoped to each project.
聊天始终绑定各自项目。
slogan: Lead an AI team. Keep your projects moving forward.
让你带领一支 AI 团队，把项目持续做成。
starter: Enter your idea, then let AI help bring it to life.
输入你的想法，然后让AI帮你实现
homeNote: Start with a thought. No project or file is required.
先说出想法，无需先建项目或导入资料。
accountNote: Your TWOS data is stored on this Mac. Email sign-in does not sync projects to other devices.
TWOS 数据保存在本机。邮箱登录不意味着项目已跨设备同步。
authIntro: Your ideas. A team to make them happen.
你的想法，由 AI 团队一起实现。
authStory: Discuss the idea, hand over the work, and keep the result — without losing the conversation.
讨论想法、交接执行、保留成果，让每一步始终接得上。
welcomeHint: Create an account with your email, or return to your existing TWOS workspace.
使用邮箱创建账号，或登录并返回已有的 TWOS 工作环境。
signupEmailNote: Use an email address you can verify. This is a TWOS account, not your ChatGPT login.
使用可以验证的邮箱。这是 TWOS 账号，不是你的 ChatGPT 登录。
verifyDesc: Enter the six-digit code for the email shown below.
请输入发送至下方邮箱的六位验证码。
codeExpiry: The latest code expires in 10 minutes. Resending replaces the previous code.
最新验证码 10 分钟内有效；重发后旧验证码失效。
verifiedDesc: Your email is verified. Your new workspace starts empty.
邮箱验证完成。你的新工作环境从空白开始。
loginNote: Log in to your TWOS account. Your AI services connect separately.
登录你的 TWOS 账号。AI 服务需另行连接授权。
resetNote: Enter your email. If this account exists, we’ll send a reset code.
输入邮箱。如果账号存在，我们会发送重置验证码。
resetDone: Password reset. Log in with your new password.
密码已重置，请使用新密码登录。
identityBoundary: TWOS account ≠ ChatGPT / Codex authorization. Connecting an AI service comes after sign-in and uses its official flow.
TWOS 账号不等于 ChatGPT / Codex 授权。登录后需通过对应官方流程连接 AI 服务。
passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
两次输入的新密码不一致。
emailTaken: An account cannot be created with these details. Try logging in or recovering access.
无法使用这些信息创建账号，请尝试登录或找回账号。
invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired. Use the latest code.
验证码错误或已过期，请使用最新验证码。
rateCode: Please wait before requesting another code.
请稍候再重新发送验证码。
resendDone: If eligible, a new code has been sent. Use the latest email.
如符合条件，新验证码已发送，请使用最新邮件。
verifyFailed: This verification attempt has ended. Request a new code.
本次验证尝试已结束，请获取新验证码。
noProjectDesc: Your conversation stays intact. Create a project for execution; this does not authorize code changes.
对话将完整保留。为执行建立项目，这不授予代码修改权限。
connectDesc: Authorize TWOS to use the existing official Codex sign-in on this Mac for discussion. Uses shared ChatGPT Work / Codex allowance. No API-key fallback or additional purchase.
授权 TWOS 使用本机现有官方 Codex 登录进行对话。计入共享的 ChatGPT Work / Codex 额度。不启用 API Key 付费备选，不额外购买。
emailBlocked: Email delivery is not configured. Ask the maintainer to finish the mail connection. Existing local accounts can still sign in.
邮件服务尚未配置，请维护者完成邮件连接。已有本机账号仍可登录。
notConnected: Model not connected · connect to send
尚未连接模型 · 连接后发送
quota: Uses existing shared Work / Codex allowance; provider limits apply.
使用现有共享 Work / Codex 额度，受供应商实际限制。
consent: I authorize this connection using my existing plan.
我授权此连接使用现有套餐。
noTools: No installed Codex found. Install or sign in through the official Codex app, then return here.
未找到已安装 Codex。请通过官方 Codex App 安装或登录后返回。
prepareConsent: Prepare a reviewable handoff. This does not approve execution.
准备可审查的交接内容。此操作不批准执行。
sendConsent: Send selected attachments / search results to the model
将选中的附件 / 检索结果发送给模型
noSources: 暂无已导入的项目资料。
newProjectNote: Name the project. Your conversation will keep its identity and history.
为项目命名。对话的标识及历史保持不变。
importBoundary: Importing files does not authorize sending them to a model or executing code.
导入资料不授予模型外发或代码执行权限。
budgetNote: Application cap: 0–10 execution requests for this account. Requests already used remain counted; provider shared-plan limits still apply.
应用上限：本账号 0–10 次执行请求。已使用次数继续计数，同时遵守供应商共享套餐限额。
devPath: 干净的本机 TWOS 源码目录
codingScope: Current code adapter: bilingual noSourcesDesc guidance and its regression test in an isolated TWOS target. Review the exact files, baseline and plan before approval.
当前代码适配器：隔离 TWOS 目标中的 noSourcesDesc 双语提示及回归测试。批准前审查确切文件、基线及方案。
noHistory: 尚无对话，可在下方开始。
error: The operation could not finish. Your saved work remains available.
操作未能完成，已保存的工作仍可使用。
bind: Bind an email to this local account
proofPending: Check your inbox. Server acceptance is not proof of delivery.
请检查收件箱。服务器接受请求不等于邮件已送达。
realIdentity: Requested model; actual identity is recorded when reported by Codex.
请求模型；Codex 回报实际模型时记录其身份。
authRequired: If Codex is signed out, open the official Codex app and sign in with ChatGPT. Return here and choose Connect to recheck. Your TWOS draft stays in this account.
若 Codex 尚未登录，请打开官方 Codex App 并使用 ChatGPT 登录，然后回到此页点击“连接”重新检查。TWOS 草稿保留在本账号。
loginInvalid: Email or password was not accepted. Check your details or reset your password.
邮箱或密码未被接受，请检查输入或找回密码。
sendFailed: Mail could not be sent. Retry later or ask the maintainer to check the mail connection.
邮件发送失败，请稍后重试，或请维护者检查邮件连接。
draftConflict: This draft changed in another page. Your text is still here; copy it before reopening the saved chat.
另一页面已修改草稿。当前文字仍保留，请复制后再重新打开已保存的聊天。
pdfTextRequired: This PDF has no readable text. Attach a text PDF or images of the relevant pages.
此 PDF 没有可读取文本。请附加文本型 PDF 或相关页面图片。
developmentRequired: Enable the development workbench for this project before reviewing an isolated source folder.
请先为本项目启用开发工作台，再审查隔离源码目录。
enableDevelopmentNote: Keep this project and its chats. Enable review of an isolated TWOS source copy. You will review and confirm the source separately; this step does not read a source folder, contact a model or start work.
保留本项目及所有对话，启用隔离 TWOS 源码副本的审查入口。之后仍需单独审查并确认源码；本步骤不读取源码目录、不调用模型、不开始任务。
deleteChatNote: Move this chat to Deleted chats? You can restore it from the account menu. Its project, tasks and results remain. Stop any running response or task first.
将此聊天移到“已删除聊天”？可以在右上角账号菜单中恢复。所属项目、任务与成果保留。请先停止正在进行的回复或任务。
deletedNote: Restore a chat to its original project or recent chats. Restoring does not resend messages or restart tasks.
恢复后，聊天回到原项目或最近聊天。恢复不会重新发送消息或执行任务。
chatBusy: Stop the current response or task before deleting this chat.
请先停止当前回复或任务，再删除聊天。
chatDeleted: This chat has been deleted. Restore it from the account menu to continue.
此聊天已删除。可从账号菜单恢复后继续。
responseInterrupted: Response interrupted. Send another message when ready.
回复已中断。准备好后可继续发送消息。
responseFailed: The response could not finish. Your message is saved; details are below.
回复未能完成。你的消息已保存，原因可在下方查看。
replanNote: Create a new plan for the same saved handoff using one model request. Previous results and failed changes stay preserved. The new plan requires a new approval and a separate Start.
对同一份已保存交接重新规划，消耗一次模型请求。原结果及失败改动保留。新方案必须重新批准，并单独点击开始。
providerQuota: Usage limits are set by your connected provider. TWOS adds no invocation limit.
额度以所连接服务商为准，TWOS 不另设调用次数上限。
error.PROJECT_EXECUTION_BUSY: This project is already working. Add instructions in the Codex pane, or hand over the next task when it finishes.
项目已有工作正在执行。可在 Codex 栏补充意见，或等当前工作结束后交付下一项。
error.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: This decision is no longer pending. The latest progress is shown in the Codex pane.
该决定已不再等待处理，请查看 Codex 栏的最新进展。
error.DELIVERY_CHANGED: The deliverable or configuration has changed. Read the updated card and hand it to Codex when ready.
交付内容或配置已更新。阅读最新卡片后即可交给 Codex。
error.WORKSPACE_NOT_EMPTY: This project already contains files. Continue with its current source, or create a new project for another source folder.
当前项目已有文件。可继续修改现有源码，或为另一份源码新建项目。
error.PERMISSION_OUTSIDE_PROJECT: The request reaches outside this project. Ask Codex to keep the work in the project workspace.
请求超出了本项目范围，请让 Codex 在项目工作目录内完成。
error.PERMISSION_SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED: This request does not specify a permission scope TWOS can preserve. Reject it and ask Codex for a project-scoped alternative.
该请求没有可保留项目边界的明确权限范围。请拒绝，并让 Codex 改用项目内方式。
error.REVIEW_READ_ONLY: Independent review can inspect this project but cannot change its files.
独立复核可以检查项目，但不能修改项目文件。
error.SOURCE_CHANGED: The source copy changed during preparation. Select the folder again to review the current files.
准备过程中源码副本发生变化，请重新选择目录审查当前文件。
error.SOURCE_EMPTY: No supported source files were found in the selected folder.
所选目录中没有可导入的源码文件。
error.SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: This source selection is too large. Select the source folder without generated files or dependencies.
所选源码过大，请选择不含生成文件和依赖目录的源码文件夹。
error.ARTIFACT_CHANGED: The saved file no longer matches its delivery record. The project and conversation are still available.
保存文件与交付记录不一致，项目和对话仍可使用。
error.PROVIDER_ALLOWANCE_UNAVAILABLE: Your provider reports that its allowance is unavailable. Progress is saved; continue when the provider allows it.
服务商返回额度暂不可用。进度已保存，额度恢复后可继续。
error.PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED: The provider connection was interrupted. Progress is saved; you can continue from here.
服务商连接已中断。进度已保存，可从当前步骤继续。
error.MODEL_NOT_ADVERTISED: This model is not in the selected Codex client’s model list. Check the connection before sending again.
所选 Codex 客户端的模型列表中没有此模型。请检查连接后重新发送。
error.MODEL_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The selected client did not return its model list. Retry the connection.
所选客户端未返回模型列表，请重新连接。
error.CODEX_MODEL_BINDING_CHANGED: Codex changed the requested model. Work stopped; choose the model before continuing.
Codex 返回的模型与所选模型不同，工作已停止，请先确认模型再继续。
error.PROJECT_REQUIRED_FOR_CONFIGURATION: Project settings become available with your first deliverable.
首次准备交付时会建立项目，随后可以更新项目配置。
error.SOURCE_PATH_CONFLICT: The source selection has a file and directory at the same path. Check the selected files.
源码中有文件与目录路径冲突，请检查所选文件。
summaryTruncated: The displayed summary has been shortened.
此段摘要较长，显示已截短。
progress.PROVIDER_CONNECTED: 已连接，正在等待模型响应…
progress.PROVIDER_THINKING: 正在思考 · 摘要见下方
progress.CLI_MODEL_METADATA_FALLBACK: The selected client could not find this model in its local catalog.
所选客户端未在本地目录中找到该模型信息。
progress.CLI_RECONNECTING: Codex 客户端正在重新连接…
progress.CLI_HTTPS_TRANSPORT_RECOVERY: The Codex client is retrying over HTTPS…
Codex 客户端正在改用 HTTPS 连接…
error.PROVIDER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The selected Codex client or account does not support this model. Check the connection and select a compatible client, then resend your message.
所选 Codex 客户端或账号不支持此模型。请检查连接，选择支持该模型的客户端后重新发送消息。
error.PROVIDER_AUTH_REQUIRED: The Codex client needs you to sign in with your ChatGPT account. Check the connection after signing in.
Codex 客户端需要登录 ChatGPT 账号。登录后请检查连接。
error.EXECUTABLE_MISSING_OR_CHANGED: The connected Codex client moved or changed. Check the connection to select it again.
已连接的 Codex 客户端已移动或更新，请检查连接并重新选择。
error.EXECUTOR_CONFIGURATION_UNSUPPORTED: This Codex client does not support the required connection settings. Select an up-to-date installed client.
此 Codex 客户端不支持所需连接设置，请选择本机已更新的客户端。
error.EXECUTION_TIMEOUT: The model did not finish before the response timeout. Your message is saved; you can resend it.
模型未在等待时间内完成回复。你的消息已保存，可重新发送。
error.PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED: The provider could not complete the request. Your message is saved; check the connection and try again.
服务商未能完成请求。你的消息已保存，请检查连接后重试。
diagnosticUnavailable: No further diagnostic information was saved.
noAutomaticReplay: This request will not be sent again automatically.
此请求不会自动重新发送。
connectionRepairHint: An installed desktop Codex client is selected below for review. Confirm Connect to use it; your model and saved conversation remain. Then resend your message.
下方已选中本机桌面应用附带的 Codex 客户端供你核对。确认连接后生效，所选模型及聊天记录保留。随后可重新发送消息。
connectionUpdateHint: Select an installed Codex client that supports your model, then confirm Connect. Your saved conversation remains.
请选择支持所需模型的本机 Codex 客户端，然后确认连接。已保存的聊天记录保留。
